system.description: Beginning at 14th level, you gain the ability to counterattack when your target tries to sabotage you. If your Primary Target forces you to make a saving throw, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack against them. This attack is made before the resolution of the saving throw. On a successful attack, you gain advantage on the saving throw.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
